newsitem.title: JORDAN: Japan lends Jordan $61 mln for school projects.
newsitem.headline: Japan lends Jordan $61 mln for school projects.

text.p: Japan agreed on Tuesday to loan Jordan $61 million on concessionary terms to help fund school building and provide special educational equipment, the Japanese embassy said.
It said in a statement the loan, with interest of 2.7 percent, would be repayed over 30 years, including a 10 year grace period.
The agreement was signed by Japanese ambassador Takayuki Kimura and Jordan's Planning Minister Rima Khalaf.

Kimura said in a statement the loan would help education projects for girls. "This project is expected to improve not only educational quality but also the capabilities and the social status of women," he said.
The embassy said the cumulative total of Japanese soft loans to Jordan was about $1.9 billion.
